description:
List the twelve Fortitude21 product categories with their slugs, taglines and product counts, in two families.
Use when: you need a category slug for search_products, or want to show the user the range. Instead: search_products to list the products themselves.
Inputs: family narrows the list to one family; any other value returns ok:false.
Returns: total, categories (slug, name, family, tagline, url, product_count, and listed_count, which adds products cross-listed into the category) and families with what each covers.
Behaviour: read-only; the list changes only when the catalogue does. Each product has one home category and may be cross-listed into others, so listed_count can exceed product_count.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.

family.description: Optional. container: cans, pails, tins and drums. system: spill containment, closures, pouring and handling. Leave out for all twelve categories

name: get_product_categories

assumed.description: Each value the tool inferred or defaulted, in words, so it can be checked with the user

categories.description: One per category: slug (for search_products), name, tagline, family, product count and url

ok.description: true with an answer. false when the tool needs one more input or cannot answer; error then says what to send
